mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c_job_application (worker_id, job_id, company_id, status, applied_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{jobId}, #{companyId}, #{status}, #{appliedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
